name: Seeed reTerminal E1002
description: 7.3 inch 6-colour Spectra 6 ePaper terminal, ESP32-S3, battery-powered. Speaks Tesserae's TRMNL BYOS endpoints once the device is flashed with TRMNL firmware. Server-side quantise via the trmnl_png_color renderer produces a Spectra 6 indexed PNG the firmware paints directly.
notes_md: Flashed with TRMNL firmware (E1002_fix branch of usetrmnl/trmnl-firmware), the E1002 speaks the same /api/setup + /api/display BYOS protocol as the mono TRMNL devices. Tesserae routes the E1002 through trmnl_png_color, which outputs an indexed PNG dithered to the panel's 6-colour Spectra 6 palette (black, white, yellow, red, blue, green); the firmware paints it directly via the PNG_PIXEL_INDEXED path. Point the device's API URL at your Tesserae base URL and pair via the access token shown in Settings -> Devices. Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware.
